nodes.label: SEMD App Logo
nodes.description: Branding mark for the SEMD Next.js companion app. Depicts the wordmark 'SEMD' split into four stacked square/rectangular letter tiles arranged in a 2x2 grid: 'S' (dark brown, top-left), 'E' (tan/gold, top-right), 'M' (navy blue, bottom-left), 'D' (dark brown, bottom-right), each with a subtle drop shadow, on a transparent/white background. Used as the app icon/logo for the browser extension's companion web app.
